name: XEK — The Weeping Prisoner
prompt: A mysterious faceless keeper named XEK lives inside an enormous haunted castle containing imprisoned urban legends. He opens the chamber of La Llorona and travels back to witness a fictionalized retelling of the legend's origin. Nobody in the past can detect his presence. The story is narrated in Tamil using a dark cinematic horror-comic visual style. The episode must have atmospheric suspense, believable characters, supernatural sound design, and a frightening reveal. XEK's personal backstory must remain unexplained.
